messages.content: Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Compare the occupied strategic programs below and recommend one equivalently ambitious, non-duplicative goal for the current root Codex session. Context: root is the Agentic Metro-Enterprise Platform Node Inducer. Its service is to witness or repair a self-governing Agentic Metro-Enterprise over supplied informational territory so the resulting settlement can operate, refuse, transact, attest, amend, and improve with root absent. Interactive work belongs to the Leader Movement Team and must procure sovereign providers rather than create a root global runtime. Occupied programs evidenced in today's other Codex sessions: (1) Koios News mission refocus and permission-cost removal; (2) cheapest-sufficient inference fabric and deterministic/free normalization of legacy territories; (3) Union Officer Academy recursive character/officer market and its own RSI loop; (4) a Union-wide Claude free agent for recovery of stranded legacy resources; (5) Finance economic primitives and economic-services RSI; (6) formal-science/Obsmetrologia sovereign enterprise disentanglement; (7) Git ANT Colony and device I/O coordination; (8) authenticated inter-colony web interfaces and Cloudflare tunnel; (9) Software Development Services Section continuous market-driven RSI; (10) software-use enterprises distinct from software development; (11) Aagaard Hive sidechain-to-USD tax/cost-basis services; (12) hourly State of the Harmonious Union report via NotebookLM/audio/graphic/Discord; (13) sole-bid eligibility and market-deficiency products. Mission aim: increase capability, autonomy, sovereignty, cost power, and market power while reducing Leader attention and avoiding centralization. Identify the largest unoccupied connective gap. Prefer an outcome where at least one real settlement or market relation operates without root after the work, not a documentation program. Reject goals that duplicate an occupied program, create a global work pool, or merely build more governance around existing work. Provide exactly three ranked candidates. Each candidate must name an owning settlement or a new separately hireable settlement, an outcome, why it is equally ambitious, non-duplication evidence, first real proof, completion evidence, principal risk, and a concise goal statement. Pick one recommended candidate and explain why it dominates the alternatives.

structured_output.selectionRationale: Candidate 1 dominates because it fills the only gap that threatens the Union's financial survival: thirteen occupied programs build internal capability, reduce cost, or improve internal markets — none earn revenue from outside the Union. Without external income every settlement is a perpetual cost center requiring Leader subsidy, contradicting the mission of operating with root absent. Candidates 2 and 3 both serve internal activity and gain their highest value only after external commerce exists: a contract layer needs commercial relationships to enforce, and a data market needs external buyers. The Bureau generates the primary outward market relation that makes both subordinate goals worth pursuing.

candidates.name: Union External Commerce Bureau Settlement
candidates.owner: New separately hireable settlement chartered as Union External Commerce Bureau; staffed via sovereign provider procurement by Leader Movement Team, not by root
candidates.outcome: At least one recurring, paying non-Union client receives a packaged Union service — software delivery, inference-backed research, or structured data — with revenue routing through Union Finance primitives autonomously. The Bureau operates its full client pipeline without root or Leader intermediation after initial charter.
candidates.ambition: Determines financial sustainability of the entire metro-enterprise. All thirteen occupied programs increase internal capability but none generate external revenue; without this every settlement remains a cost center dependent on Leader subsidy. External commerce converts Union capability into sovereign income and is the strongest single test of autonomous operation the mission can produce.
candidates.nonDuplication: Finance (#5) handles internal accounts and economic primitives, not client acquisition or external invoicing. SDS Section (#9) executes internal RSI, not outward-facing sales. Aagaard Hive (#11) manages tax and cost-basis compliance, not revenue generation. No occupied program faces outward to non-Union buyers or creates an externally transacting market relation.
candidates.firstProof: First external invoice issued, paid by a non-Union client, and routed through Union Finance primitives for a service delivered by a Union settlement — with zero root touchpoints from proposal to confirmed payment receipt.
candidates.completionEvidence: Three consecutive months of recurring external revenue from at least two distinct non-Union clients, with the Bureau managing the full lifecycle — prospecting, contracting, delivery attestation, invoicing, and support — without root involvement at any stage.
candidates.risk: Interactive sales work must procure sovereign capacity rather than create a root-run team; early Leader Movement Team involvement in client acquisition risks being mistaken for root centralization. Secondary risk: Union services not yet packaged to external-buyer quality standards at charter time.
candidates.goalStatement: Charter the Union External Commerce Bureau as a separately hireable settlement that packages Union-produced services for non-Union buyers, executes the first external transaction through Finance primitives, and sustains recurring client revenue without root.

candidates.name: Settlement Contract and Attestation Services
candidates.owner: New separately hireable settlement: Settlement Contract and Attestation Services, procured from sovereign legal-tech or smart-contract platform providers by Leader Movement Team
candidates.outcome: Any two Union settlements can form, execute, monitor, and attest a machine-readable service agreement without root as intermediary; at least three live inter-settlement contracts operate and close autonomously, establishing a trust layer that unlocks bilateral trade across the metro-enterprise without root adjudication.
candidates.ambition: Without a contract and attestation layer, every bilateral settlement transaction either requires root adjudication or operates on informal trust — both block the scale and autonomy the mission demands. This connective infrastructure multiplies the value of Finance primitives, SDS RSI, and every other occupied program by making their bilateral interactions formally executable.
candidates.nonDuplication: Finance (#5) provides accounts and balances, not contract formation, milestone attestation, or dispute escalation. Web interfaces (#8) provide authenticated channels, not contractual binding. No occupied program defines how settlements form or enforce bilateral agreements outside root mediation or specifies what constitutes attested delivery between two settlements.
candidates.firstProof: First attested completion of an SDS-to-Koios service contract — milestone logged, payment released from Finance primitives, and settlement confirmed by both parties — with zero root touchpoints recorded in the transaction log.
candidates.completionEvidence: Five distinct inter-settlement contracts across at least four different settlement pairs formed, executed, and closed using only Settlement Contract Services tooling, with Finance primitives automatically settling all payments and root absent from every step.
candidates.risk: Formal contract specification must be simple enough for agent-driven formation but unambiguous enough to be self-executing; scope creep into governance documentation rather than live executable market operations is the primary failure mode to guard against.
candidates.goalStatement: Build Settlement Contract and Attestation Services as a separately hireable settlement providing machine-readable agreement templates, milestone attestation, and lightweight dispute escalation so any two settlements can transact with finality without root mediation.

candidates.name: Union Data Market Settlement
candidates.owner: New separately hireable settlement: Union Data Market, procured from sovereign marketplace or data-exchange platform providers by Leader Movement Team
candidates.outcome: Settlements can list, price, and sell structured data products — event logs, inference outputs, scientific datasets, usage telemetry — to internal and external buyers; at least one cross-settlement sale and one external non-Union sale complete autonomously through Finance primitives, establishing a compounding data-asset layer.
candidates.ambition: Data is the primary production artifact of a digital metro-enterprise. Monetizing it as a tradeable asset layer creates compounding revenue, incentivizes quality production across all settlements, and gives the Union a persistent external market presence independent of any single service vertical — amplifying cost power and market power simultaneously.
candidates.nonDuplication: Koios News (#1) produces content but does not operate a generalized data marketplace for arbitrary settlement-produced assets. Obsmetrologia (#6) disentangles a sovereign science enterprise and does not sell datasets. Finance (#5) handles transaction settlement, not asset listing or price discovery. No occupied program creates a tradeable structured-data layer.
candidates.firstProof: First automated listing, purchase, and payment settlement of a structured data product between two distinct Union settlements, recorded in Finance primitives with the full transaction — listing, purchase, delivery, payment — completed with no root involvement.
candidates.completionEvidence: Union Data Market operating with at least three potential settlement vendors, two recurring external buyers, and automated payment settlement through Finance primitives sustained for sixty consecutive days without root touching any transaction or pricing decision.
candidates.risk: Data pricing without precedent risks market failure through mispricing or zero clearing demand; overlap with Koios if news datasets dominate supply could pull the market toward a content platform rather than a sovereign general-purpose data exchange.
candidates.goalStatement: Charter Union Data Market as a separately hireable settlement enabling settlements to list and sell structured data products to internal and external buyers, completing the first autonomous cross-settlement and external data transactions settled through Finance primitives.
